meta.title: Prelude of Honor
meta.description: The clarion announcing the arrival of a dignitary echoes through the Oasis.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Medical Department.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Medical Department.

spans.text: The Oasis, Medical Department.

units.rawText: A pink-haired figure hidden behind a pillar near the door writes away fervently.
units.displayText: A pink-haired figure hidden behind a pillar near the door writes away fervently.

spans.text: A pink-haired figure hidden behind a pillar near the door writes away fervently.

units.rawText: Logged ID, Undine, model, E-Orchestra. Past experience... Previously an accomplished star.
units.displayText: Logged ID, Undine, model, E-Orchestra. Past experience... Previously an accomplished star.

spans.text: Logged ID, Undine, model, E-Orchestra. Past experience... Previously an accomplished star.

units.rawText: "A sudden reappearance of a former star in the Oasis? The matter that's been keeping everyone up at night... Find out in this editorial from the frontlines!" Hehe, that'll do nicely for the headline!
units.displayText: "A sudden reappearance of a former star in the Oasis? The matter that's been keeping everyone up at night... Find out in this editorial from the frontlines!" Hehe, that'll do nicely for the headline!

units.rawText: Eh? You are...
units.displayText: Eh? You are...

spans.text: Eh? You are...

units.rawText: Finally! Thank you for your work, Miss De Lacey! How is Undine? Is she out of the red?
units.displayText: Finally! Thank you for your work, Miss De Lacey! How is Undine? Is she out of the red?

spans.text: Finally! Thank you for your work, Miss De Lacey! How is Undine? Is she out of the red?

units.rawText: Huh, how did you...
units.displayText: Huh, how did you...

spans.text: Huh, how did you...

units.rawText: It's only natural! For an ambassador of the Guardians to stay a whole three days at the Oasis, working tirelessly to take care of a companion, it's a story worthy of recognition. As the number one reporter in the Oasis, of course I noticed!
units.displayText: It's only natural! For an ambassador of the Guardians to stay a whole three days at the Oasis, working tirelessly to take care of a companion, it's a story worthy of recognition. As the number one reporter in the Oasis, of course I noticed!

units.rawText: Thanks to everyone here at the Oasis, she's in a stable condition now. If you're looking for an interview, come again another day. She needs more rest right now.
units.displayText: Thanks to everyone here at the Oasis, she's in a stable condition now. If you're looking for an interview, come again another day. She needs more rest right now.

spans.text: Thanks to everyone here at the Oasis, she's in a stable condition now. If you're looking for an interview, come again another day. She needs more rest right now.

units.rawText: Ah—Certainly, I'd better leave her to rest then. An interview is important, of course, but health comes first...
units.displayText: Ah—Certainly, I'd better leave her to rest then. An interview is important, of course, but health comes first...

spans.text: Ah—Certainly, I'd better leave her to rest then. An interview is important, of course, but health comes first...

units.rawText: Thank you, it's rare to see journalists as respectful to patients as you.
units.displayText: Thank you, it's rare to see journalists as respectful to patients as you.

spans.text: Thank you, it's rare to see journalists as respectful to patients as you.

units.rawText: Willow gives an embarrassed chuckle. At the same time, another pair of footsteps gradually approaches...
units.displayText: Willow gives an embarrassed chuckle. At the same time, another pair of footsteps gradually approaches...

spans.text: Willow gives an embarrassed chuckle. At the same time, another pair of footsteps gradually approaches...

units.rawText: Ehh? The Prof's here too? To see Miss Undine?
units.displayText: Ehh? The Prof's here too? To see Miss Undine?

spans.text: Ehh? The Prof's here too? To see Miss Undine?

units.rawText: Yeah, the Medical Department reported neural stability yesterday. I'm here to note what's happened today, and proceed with the request that De Lacey put in.
units.displayText: Yeah, the Medical Department reported neural stability yesterday. I'm here to note what's happened today, and proceed with the request that De Lacey put in.

spans.text: Yeah, the Medical Department reported neural stability yesterday. I'm here to note what's happened today, and proceed with the request that De Lacey put in.

units.rawText: Oh... Oh! Miss De Lacey was saying that she hoped that we could keep Miss Undine here at the Oasis! So that means...
units.displayText: Oh... Oh! Miss De Lacey was saying that she hoped that we could keep Miss Undine here at the Oasis! So that means...

spans.text: Oh... Oh! Miss De Lacey was saying that she hoped that we could keep Miss Undine here at the Oasis! So that means...

units.rawText: There's still hope for my headline?!
units.displayText: There's still hope for my headline?!

spans.text: There's still hope for my headline?!

units.rawText: If everything goes well, there might be, yes.
units.displayText: If everything goes well, there might be, yes.

spans.text: If everything goes well, there might be, yes.

units.rawText: However, you might need to wait—
units.displayText: However, you might need to wait—

spans.text: However, you might need to wait—

units.rawText: Hang on, Miss De Lacey, behind you!
units.displayText: Hang on, Miss De Lacey, behind you!

spans.text: Hang on, Miss De Lacey, behind you!

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: De Lacey turns around subconsciously. At the same time, a few figures emerge from behind her, lining up in an orderly manner to her left and right.
units.displayText: De Lacey turns around subconsciously. At the same time, a few figures emerge from behind her, lining up in an orderly manner to her left and right.

spans.text: De Lacey turns around subconsciously. At the same time, a few figures emerge from behind her, lining up in an orderly manner to her left and right.

units.rawText: Greetings, esteemed <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Greetings, esteemed {교수}.

spans.text: Greetings, esteemed

units.rawText: Unni?!
units.displayText: Unni?!

spans.text: Unni?!

units.rawText: As the Doll in the middle bows, the remainder of the lineup follows suit, lowering themselves to one knee.
units.displayText: As the Doll in the middle bows, the remainder of the lineup follows suit, lowering themselves to one knee.

spans.text: As the Doll in the middle bows, the remainder of the lineup follows suit, lowering themselves to one knee.

units.rawText: <size=28>Uwah, what are these grand courtesies... Is this what Dolls that live in high society are like? Scary...</size>
units.displayText: Uwah, what are these grand courtesies... Is this what Dolls that live in high society are like? Scary...

spans.text: Uwah, what are these grand courtesies... Is this what Dolls that live in high society are like? Scary...

units.rawText: <size=28>Didn't you just say earlier that they weren't too well? To show up like this and make these big gestures, surely they aren't pushing themselves...</size>
units.displayText: Didn't you just say earlier that they weren't too well? To show up like this and make these big gestures, surely they aren't pushing themselves...

spans.text: Didn't you just say earlier that they weren't too well? To show up like this and make these big gestures, surely they aren't pushing themselves...

units.rawText: This...
units.displayText: This...

spans.text: This...

units.rawText: <size=28>Cough, Professor, as unique as this is, they are expressing their genuine gratitude and respect.</size>
units.displayText: Cough, Professor, as unique as this is, they are expressing their genuine gratitude and respect.

spans.text: Cough, Professor, as unique as this is, they are expressing their genuine gratitude and respect.

units.rawText: I apologize if I startled you. It was the only way we can express our thanks.
units.displayText: I apologize if I startled you. It was the only way we can express our thanks.

spans.text: I apologize if I startled you. It was the only way we can express our thanks.

units.rawText: The leading Doll produces a staff bearing a flag, shifts formation and position with her aides, and makes another grandiose display.
units.displayText: The leading Doll produces a staff bearing a flag, shifts formation and position with her aides, and makes another grandiose display.

spans.text: The leading Doll produces a staff bearing a flag, shifts formation and position with her aides, and makes another grandiose display.

units.rawText: I am Undine. As you can see, I am the captain of this ceremonial orchestra.
units.displayText: I am Undine. As you can see, I am the captain of this ceremonial orchestra.

spans.text: I am Undine. As you can see, I am the captain of this ceremonial orchestra.

units.rawText: Hello, Undine. I am the head of the Oasis, <cmdr>. There's no need to be so formal. You can call me Professor like everyone else.
units.displayText: Hello, Undine. I am the head of the Oasis, {교수}. There's no need to be so formal. You can call me Professor like everyone else.

spans.text: Hello, Undine. I am the head of the Oasis,
. There's no need to be so formal. You can call me Professor like everyone else.

units.rawText: Yes, understood, most gracious <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Yes, understood, most gracious {교수}.

spans.text: Yes, understood, most gracious

units.rawText: Ah, let me introduce you. Professor, this is the ceremonial orchestra's main unit, and the little guys behind Unni are her aides. They've always moved as a group.
units.displayText: Ah, let me introduce you. Professor, this is the ceremonial orchestra's main unit, and the little guys behind Unni are her aides. They've always moved as a group.

spans.text: Ah, let me introduce you. Professor, this is the ceremonial orchestra's main unit, and the little guys behind Unni are her aides. They've always moved as a group.

units.rawText: This is the Professor, and you'll be under their command at the Oasis from now on! If you're feeling better, let's go have a look at your neural cloud.
units.displayText: This is the Professor, and you'll be under their command at the Oasis from now on! If you're feeling better, let's go have a look at your neural cloud.

spans.text: This is the Professor, and you'll be under their command at the Oasis from now on! If you're feeling better, let's go have a look at your neural cloud.

units.rawText: <size=28>Ohhh, so De Lacey can be like this too; let me note this down...</size>
units.displayText: Ohhh, so De Lacey can be like this too; let me note this down...

spans.text: Ohhh, so De Lacey can be like this too; let me note this down...

units.rawText: <size=28>Then again, that big star was staring at De Lacey the entire time she was talking.</size>
units.displayText: Then again, that big star was staring at De Lacey the entire time she was talking.

spans.text: Then again, that big star was staring at De Lacey the entire time she was talking.

units.rawText: <size=28>On top of how much effort De Lacey has put into caring for her, there's gotta be something deeper between the two... Hehe, that's the smell of a banger!</size>
units.displayText: On top of how much effort De Lacey has put into caring for her, there's gotta be something deeper between the two... Hehe, that's the smell of a banger!

spans.text: On top of how much effort De Lacey has put into caring for her, there's gotta be something deeper between the two... Hehe, that's the smell of a banger!

units.rawText: If it's a neural inspection, I can come along too!
units.displayText: If it's a neural inspection, I can come along too!

spans.text: If it's a neural inspection, I can come along too!

units.rawText: No, beautiful miss, and Professor <cmdr>... I must decline. We cannot remain here.
units.displayText: No, beautiful miss, and Professor {교수}... I must decline. We cannot remain here.

spans.text: No, beautiful miss, and Professor
... I must decline. We cannot remain here.

units.rawText: Ehhh? Why? But the Professor is so nice!
units.displayText: Ehhh? Why? But the Professor is so nice!

spans.text: Ehhh? Why? But the Professor is so nice!

units.rawText: Undine, perhaps you're not fully adjusted yet after awakening, but we harbor no ill will. Please rest assured.
units.displayText: Undine, perhaps you're not fully adjusted yet after awakening, but we harbor no ill will. Please rest assured.

spans.text: Undine, perhaps you're not fully adjusted yet after awakening, but we harbor no ill will. Please rest assured.

units.rawText: Thank you, truly, for your help. I will repay this favor one day, whether it be with money, or some other way.
units.displayText: Thank you, truly, for your help. I will repay this favor one day, whether it be with money, or some other way.

spans.text: Thank you, truly, for your help. I will repay this favor one day, whether it be with money, or some other way.

units.rawText: And De... That person beside you, I am immensely grateful for her help and healing as well. It's just that... For personal reasons, it would be inconvenient for me to remain here.
units.displayText: And De... That person beside you, I am immensely grateful for her help and healing as well. It's just that... For personal reasons, it would be inconvenient for me to remain here.

spans.text: And De... That person beside you, I am immensely grateful for her help and healing as well. It's just that... For personal reasons, it would be inconvenient for me to remain here.

units.rawText: Wait! Unni, whether it's getting back to reality or protecting those girls next to you, you're best off staying with the Professor. You were mumbling that stuff even when you were out cold!
units.displayText: Wait! Unni, whether it's getting back to reality or protecting those girls next to you, you're best off staying with the Professor. You were mumbling that stuff even when you were out cold!

spans.text: Wait! Unni, whether it's getting back to reality or protecting those girls next to you, you're best off staying with the Professor. You were mumbling that stuff even when you were out cold!

units.rawText: You misunderstand. That was merely... a bit of data disorder after being injured. Pay no mind to those ramblings.
units.displayText: You misunderstand. That was merely... a bit of data disorder after being injured. Pay no mind to those ramblings.

spans.text: You misunderstand. That was merely... a bit of data disorder after being injured. Pay no mind to those ramblings.

units.rawText: Casting the befuddled De Lacey aside, the Undine Ceremonial Orchestra's main unit looks towards me.
units.displayText: Casting the befuddled De Lacey aside, the Undine Ceremonial Orchestra's main unit looks towards me.

spans.text: Casting the befuddled De Lacey aside, the Undine Ceremonial Orchestra's main unit looks towards me.

units.rawText: Professor <cmdr>, my apologies, I've made quite the fool of myself.
units.displayText: Professor {교수}, my apologies, I've made quite the fool of myself.

spans.text: Professor
, my apologies, I've made quite the fool of myself.

units.rawText: Don't worry, I don't mind that stuff. If you say it like that...
units.displayText: Don't worry, I don't mind that stuff. If you say it like that...

spans.text: Don't worry, I don't mind that stuff. If you say it like that...
Stop her
Relent

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers are not the only threat lurking outside. It's nigh impossible to send a distress signal out in the Null Areas, and if you weren't close to the route De Lacey took towards the Oasis, she might not even have picked you up.
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers are not the only threat lurking outside. It's nigh impossible to send a distress signal out in the Null Areas, and if you weren't close to the route De Lacey took towards the Oasis, she might not even have picked you up.

spans.text: The Sanctifiers are not the only threat lurking outside. It's nigh impossible to send a distress signal out in the Null Areas, and if you weren't close to the route De Lacey took towards the Oasis, she might not even have picked you up.

units.rawText: You're still wounded, and if you run into some sort of danger again, you might not be as lucky the next time.
units.displayText: You're still wounded, and if you run into some sort of danger again, you might not be as lucky the next time.

spans.text: You're still wounded, and if you run into some sort of danger again, you might not be as lucky the next time.

units.rawText: But, I—
units.displayText: But, I—

spans.text: But, I—

units.rawText: Even if you aren't willing to think for yourself, think of those guys behind you.
units.displayText: Even if you aren't willing to think for yourself, think of those guys behind you.

spans.text: Even if you aren't willing to think for yourself, think of those guys behind you.

units.rawText: If that is what you desire, then we will respect your decision. We do not force anything upon Dolls here.
units.displayText: If that is what you desire, then we will respect your decision. We do not force anything upon Dolls here.

spans.text: If that is what you desire, then we will respect your decision. We do not force anything upon Dolls here.

units.rawText: The Ceremonial Orchestra expresses endless gratitude for your tolerance and understanding.
units.displayText: The Ceremonial Orchestra expresses endless gratitude for your tolerance and understanding.

spans.text: The Ceremonial Orchestra expresses endless gratitude for your tolerance and understanding.

units.rawText: But those wounds on you won't go away, will they? The next time you run into a similar situation, someone might not be there for you.
units.displayText: But those wounds on you won't go away, will they? The next time you run into a similar situation, someone might not be there for you.

spans.text: But those wounds on you won't go away, will they? The next time you run into a similar situation, someone might not be there for you.

units.rawText: Well...
units.displayText: Well...

spans.text: Well...

units.rawText: Whatever it is you have to attend to, it can wait until you're healed.
units.displayText: Whatever it is you have to attend to, it can wait until you're healed.

spans.text: Whatever it is you have to attend to, it can wait until you're healed.

units.rawText: But, De Lacey...
units.displayText: But, De Lacey...

spans.text: But, De Lacey...

units.rawText: Unni? What is it?
units.displayText: Unni? What is it?

spans.text: Unni? What is it?

units.rawText: <size=28>De Lacey? She sure seems to care a lot about De Lacey, hmm?</size>
units.displayText: De Lacey? She sure seems to care a lot about De Lacey, hmm?

spans.text: De Lacey? She sure seems to care a lot about De Lacey, hmm?

units.rawText: (I see. She seems rather friendly with De Lacey. Undine's worried about De Lacey's affiliation with the "Guardians", and the improprieties associated with that.)
units.displayText: I see. She seems rather friendly with De Lacey. Undine's worried about De Lacey's affiliation with the "Guardians", and the improprieties associated with that.

spans.text: I see. She seems rather friendly with De Lacey. Undine's worried about De Lacey's affiliation with the "Guardians", and the improprieties associated with that.

units.rawText: Undine, we've requested many people to assist the Oasis in rescuing and recovering Dolls, the Guardians included.
units.displayText: Undine, we've requested many people to assist the Oasis in rescuing and recovering Dolls, the Guardians included.

spans.text: Undine, we've requested many people to assist the Oasis in rescuing and recovering Dolls, the Guardians included.

units.rawText: If you were to help search for the still lost Dolls of Project Neural Cloud, that would be an immense help.
units.displayText: If you were to help search for the still lost Dolls of Project Neural Cloud, that would be an immense help.

spans.text: If you were to help search for the still lost Dolls of Project Neural Cloud, that would be an immense help.

units.rawText: We have no need for your money. You can repay the favor this way. Is that acceptable?
units.displayText: We have no need for your money. You can repay the favor this way. Is that acceptable?

spans.text: We have no need for your money. You can repay the favor this way. Is that acceptable?

units.rawText: <size=28>Mm...</size>
units.displayText: Mm...

spans.text: Mm...

units.rawText: Thank you for your understanding. On behalf of the Ceremonial Orchestra, I confer upon you the greatest gratitude.
units.displayText: Thank you for your understanding. On behalf of the Ceremonial Orchestra, I confer upon you the greatest gratitude.

spans.text: Thank you for your understanding. On behalf of the Ceremonial Orchestra, I confer upon you the greatest gratitude.

units.rawText: <size=28>Wow, all of this again... Are they always like this?</size>
units.displayText: Wow, all of this again... Are they always like this?

spans.text: Wow, all of this again... Are they always like this?

units.rawText: For the rest of the process, go with the medical Dolls on duty. I'll go prepare the neural inspection.
units.displayText: For the rest of the process, go with the medical Dolls on duty. I'll go prepare the neural inspection.

spans.text: For the rest of the process, go with the medical Dolls on duty. I'll go prepare the neural inspection.

units.rawText: De Lacey, I'll have to trouble you after their medical affairs are dealt with. Tell us if there are any issues.
units.displayText: De Lacey, I'll have to trouble you after their medical affairs are dealt with. Tell us if there are any issues.

spans.text: De Lacey, I'll have to trouble you after their medical affairs are dealt with. Tell us if there are any issues.

units.rawText: Well... If there's nothing else, I'll go back to writing up the news. Call me if anything comes up!
units.displayText: Well... If there's nothing else, I'll go back to writing up the news. Call me if anything comes up!

spans.text: Well... If there's nothing else, I'll go back to writing up the news. Call me if anything comes up!

units.displayText: Willow winks at me and skips off, tacit understanding in her eyes.

spans.text: Willow winks at me and skips off, tacit understanding in her eyes.

units.rawText: Oh... If the Professor says so, then. Unni and I will be back after we talk to everyone in the medical department.
units.displayText: Oh... If the Professor says so, then. Unni and I will be back after we talk to everyone in the medical department.

spans.text: Oh... If the Professor says so, then. Unni and I will be back after we talk to everyone in the medical department.

units.rawText: Alright, I'll take my leave then.
units.displayText: Alright, I'll take my leave then.

spans.text: Alright, I'll take my leave then.

units.rawText: Unni, what is it?
units.displayText: Unni, what is it?

spans.text: Unni, what is it?

units.rawText: Like I said, the Prof is a gentle person, and everyone else is nice too, right? No need to be so tense.
units.displayText: Like I said, the Prof is a gentle person, and everyone else is nice too, right? No need to be so tense.

spans.text: Like I said, the Prof is a gentle person, and everyone else is nice too, right? No need to be so tense.

units.rawText: De Lacey, you... Whatever, they don't seem to intend to do anything to you. I will say, however, that you should be more careful. Don't put so much faith in humans.
units.displayText: De Lacey, you... Whatever, they don't seem to intend to do anything to you. I will say, however, that you should be more careful. Don't put so much faith in humans.

spans.text: De Lacey, you... Whatever, they don't seem to intend to do anything to you. I will say, however, that you should be more careful. Don't put so much faith in humans.

units.rawText: But these people are so nice, and we even have a stable cooperative relationship! The Professor is quite affable in their own regard as well...
units.displayText: But these people are so nice, and we even have a stable cooperative relationship! The Professor is quite affable in their own regard as well...

spans.text: But these people are so nice, and we even have a stable cooperative relationship! The Professor is quite affable in their own regard as well...

units.rawText: This is someone else's territory, not the Guardians'.
units.displayText: This is someone else's territory, not the Guardians'.

spans.text: This is someone else's territory, not the Guardians'.

units.rawText: To think that you'd bring me here to the Oasis... If you were to be reprimanded for this and shunned by the Guardians, what am I to do about it?
units.displayText: To think that you'd bring me here to the Oasis... If you were to be reprimanded for this and shunned by the Guardians, what am I to do about it?

spans.text: To think that you'd bring me here to the Oasis... If you were to be reprimanded for this and shunned by the Guardians, what am I to do about it?

units.rawText: Oh, it'll be fine, the Prof and our Boss will understand, I'm sure. I'll keep it in mind though, seeing as you said it.
units.displayText: Oh, it'll be fine, the Prof and our Boss will understand, I'm sure. I'll keep it in mind though, seeing as you said it.

spans.text: Oh, it'll be fine, the Prof and our Boss will understand, I'm sure. I'll keep it in mind though, seeing as you said it.

units.rawText: You better remember to keep your guard up, you and that seven-second lifetime goldfish memory module of yours.
units.displayText: You better remember to keep your guard up, you and that seven-second lifetime goldfish memory module of yours.

spans.text: You better remember to keep your guard up, you and that seven-second lifetime goldfish memory module of yours.

units.rawText: A worrywart as always.

units.displayText: You—

spans.text: You—

units.rawText: Hehehe, even if I can't understand, it really warms my heart to see you all in such high spirits.

units.rawText: Woah! Unni, are you ok? You're not doing well at all, so why force yourself?
units.displayText: Woah! Unni, are you ok? You're not doing well at all, so why force yourself?

spans.text: Woah! Unni, are you ok? You're not doing well at all, so why force yourself?

units.rawText: It's okay, I cannot appear undignified in front of an important guest; I'm just a bit tired. You can check if you don't believe me...
units.displayText: It's okay, I cannot appear undignified in front of an important guest; I'm just a bit tired. You can check if you don't believe me...

spans.text: It's okay, I cannot appear undignified in front of an important guest; I'm just a bit tired. You can check if you don't believe me...

units.rawText: Okay. Don't move, and let me take a look...
units.displayText: Okay. Don't move, and let me take a look...

spans.text: Okay. Don't move, and let me take a look...

units.rawText: You! What are you doing? Get that stupid tentacle-tail away from me!
units.displayText: You! What are you doing? Get that stupid tentacle-tail away from me!

spans.text: You! What are you doing? Get that stupid tentacle-tail away from me!

units.rawText: <size=28>But you asked for it.</size>
units.displayText: But you asked for it.

spans.text: But you asked for it.

units.rawText: Well, if you don't feel like it, I'll just take a look at the instrument readings... Though the big issues seem to be fixed.
units.displayText: Well, if you don't feel like it, I'll just take a look at the instrument readings... Though the big issues seem to be fixed.

spans.text: Well, if you don't feel like it, I'll just take a look at the instrument readings... Though the big issues seem to be fixed.

units.rawText: There, you see? No need to be concerned, and go help out our patron. Go take care of yourself, you and that stupid chunky tail of yours.
units.displayText: There, you see? No need to be concerned, and go help out our patron. Go take care of yourself, you and that stupid chunky tail of yours.

spans.text: There, you see? No need to be concerned, and go help out our patron. Go take care of yourself, you and that stupid chunky tail of yours.

units.rawText: Hehehe, I'll go help Professor look at the inspection equipment then. Wouldn't do any good to keep them waiting.
units.displayText: Hehehe, I'll go help Professor look at the inspection equipment then. Wouldn't do any good to keep them waiting.

spans.text: Hehehe, I'll go help Professor look at the inspection equipment then. Wouldn't do any good to keep them waiting.

units.rawText: Hmph... You better remember what you said earlier.
units.displayText: Hmph... You better remember what you said earlier.

spans.text: Hmph... You better remember what you said earlier.

units.rawText: Even if you are right, you can't just treat anywhere like it's safe.
units.displayText: Even if you are right, you can't just treat anywhere like it's safe.

spans.text: Even if you are right, you can't just treat anywhere like it's safe.

units.rawText: The Oasis, Neural Inspection Lab.
units.displayText: The Oasis, Neural Inspection Lab.

spans.text: The Oasis, Neural Inspection Lab.

units.rawText: Undine stands vigilantly by the machinery, unmoving like a statue.
units.displayText: Undine stands vigilantly by the machinery, unmoving like a statue.

spans.text: Undine stands vigilantly by the machinery, unmoving like a statue.

units.rawText: Don't worry, Undine. Like I said, it's just an inspection.
units.displayText: Don't worry, Undine. Like I said, it's just an inspection.

spans.text: Don't worry, Undine. Like I said, it's just an inspection.

units.rawText: That's right! We're taking a look to see if there's any obvious neural vulnerabilities. If any exist, they require far more attention and treatment than what can be observed from the outside.
units.displayText: That's right! We're taking a look to see if there's any obvious neural vulnerabilities. If any exist, they require far more attention and treatment than what can be observed from the outside.

spans.text: That's right! We're taking a look to see if there's any obvious neural vulnerabilities. If any exist, they require far more attention and treatment than what can be observed from the outside.

units.rawText: Yes, thank you for your kindness, most esteemed <cmdr>. And... De Lacey.
units.displayText: Yes, thank you for your kindness, most esteemed {교수}. And... De Lacey.

spans.text: Yes, thank you for your kindness, most esteemed
. And... De Lacey.

units.rawText: It's just... I apologize, I'm not used to... bringing up memory data again.
units.displayText: It's just... I apologize, I'm not used to... bringing up memory data again.

spans.text: It's just... I apologize, I'm not used to... bringing up memory data again.

units.rawText:
Dididi, beeeeep—
(Scan, complete. Conclusion, safe.)
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeeep—
(Scan, complete. Conclusion, safe.)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeeep—
(Scan, complete. Conclusion, safe.)

units.rawText:
Dididi, beeeeep—
(Eliminate, problem, possibility.)
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeeep—
(Eliminate, problem, possibility.)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeeep—
(Eliminate, problem, possibility.)

units.rawText: Though if it is a request of yours, I shall not put it off any longer.
units.displayText: Though if it is a request of yours, I shall not put it off any longer.

spans.text: Though if it is a request of yours, I shall not put it off any longer.

units.rawText: Saying that, Undine rests upon the chair, and I press the button.
units.displayText: Saying that, Undine rests upon the chair, and I press the button.

spans.text: Saying that, Undine rests upon the chair, and I press the button.

units.rawText: <size=28>Unni's cautious as always... But I'm sure she'll eventually come to understand how much everyone here cares.</size>
units.displayText: Unni's cautious as always... But I'm sure she'll eventually come to understand how much everyone here cares.

spans.text: Unni's cautious as always... But I'm sure she'll eventually come to understand how much everyone here cares.

units.rawText: <size=28>No need to rush. Understanding and trust don't come without the process of testing the waters.</size>
units.displayText: No need to rush. Understanding and trust don't come without the process of testing the waters.

spans.text: No need to rush. Understanding and trust don't come without the process of testing the waters.

units.rawText: Neural scan, initiating.
units.displayText: Neural scan, initiating.

spans.text: Neural scan, initiating.

units.rawText: Extracting memory data...
units.displayText: Extracting memory data...

spans.text: Extracting memory data...

units.rawText: Ugh...!
units.displayText: Ugh...!

spans.text: Ugh...!

units.rawText: The cold automated voice and process of extraction seems to trigger some type of memory in Undine, and she begins to struggle on the operating table.
units.displayText: The cold automated voice and process of extraction seems to trigger some type of memory in Undine, and she begins to struggle on the operating table.

spans.text: The cold automated voice and process of extraction seems to trigger some type of memory in Undine, and she begins to struggle on the operating table.

units.rawText: Wait... No... We aren't...
units.displayText: Wait... No... We aren't...

spans.text: Wait... No... We aren't...

units.rawText: Unni, this isn't the time to—
units.displayText: Unni, this isn't the time to—

spans.text: Unni, this isn't the time to—

units.rawText: It's me! Calm down, you're safe now!
units.displayText: It's me! Calm down, you're safe now!

spans.text: It's me! Calm down, you're safe now!

units.rawText: Safe... Right, this isn't...
units.displayText: Safe... Right, this isn't...

spans.text: Safe... Right, this isn't...

units.rawText: Everyone is here, and De Lacey...
units.displayText: Everyone is here, and De Lacey...

spans.text: Everyone is here, and De Lacey...

units.rawText: At De Lacey's touch, something more comforting surfaces from within Undine, and she gradually relaxes.
units.displayText: At De Lacey's touch, something more comforting surfaces from within Undine, and she gradually relaxes.

spans.text: At De Lacey's touch, something more comforting surfaces from within Undine, and she gradually relaxes.

units.rawText: Calibration complete. Neural cloud restarting, projecting memory stream—
units.displayText: Calibration complete. Neural cloud restarting, projecting memory stream—

spans.text: Calibration complete. Neural cloud restarting, projecting memory stream—

units.rawText: Undine swallows her words, looking back at her aides behind her.
units.displayText: Undine swallows her words, looking back at her aides behind her.

spans.text: Undine swallows her words, looking back at her aides behind her.
